title: Unisex Christmas Raccoon – Santa's Late, I Started Without Him Crewneck Sweatshirt

seo.title: Christmas Raccoon Sweatshirt | Santa's Late, I Started Without Him
seo.description: A funny Christmas raccoon sweatshirt: a raccoon in a Santa hat drags a bag of bows under SANTA'S LATE. I STARTED WITHOUT HIM. Unisex crewneck, S–3XL.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

Santa's late, and this raccoon started without him: a Christmas raccoon sweatshirt for the one in the family who gets into the presents first. Wear it to the gift swap, the living-room floor after the unwrapping, or any holiday where the best part is the mess.

The 1950s Christmas-card style art shows a delighted raccoon in a crooked Santa hat walking upright and dragging a bulging grey bag stuffed with red and green bows and curly ribbon across a patch of snow, with a few loose bows on the ground behind it. SANTA'S LATE. runs across the top in cream on the dark sweatshirts and navy on the light ones, and I STARTED WITHOUT HIM. runs across the bottom in mustard on the dark sweatshirts and faded red on the light ones.

It makes an easy Secret Santa or stocking gift for the raccoon lover, the family member who saves the ribbon, or anyone who enjoys the mess more than the presents. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 7 colors: White, Sand, Sport Grey, Ash, Black, Navy, Forest Green

Questions

How does the Santa's Late raccoon crewneck fit?
This classic unisex Gildan 18000 crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. comes in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomy, cozy look over a long-sleeve tee. If the size is off, we offer one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

How warm is it and what is it made of?
The Santa's Late raccoon crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz per square yard, with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband and no hood. It is a mid-weight, cozy layer for Christmas morning on the living-room floor. Machine wash cold inside out and tumble dry low.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in White, Sand, Sport Grey, Ash, Black, Navy and Forest Green, all in sizes S through 3XL. On the four light colors the top line is navy and the bottom line faded red; on the three dark colors they turn cream and mustard. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order.

Who is this a good gift for?
It suits the raccoon lover, the trash panda fan and the one who opens presents before anyone else is up. It is an easy Secret Santa pick, and each Graphic Tees Co. crewneck ships in sizes S to 3XL with one free size exchange within 30 days. Orders of $45 or more ship free.

When should I order for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so the Santa's Late raccoon crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. A misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
